lines.say: Your building ranks every neighbour each month. Last place gets evicted.
You’re new. Loud music once. Late rent once. You’re in last place.
You carry Doris’s shopping. You fix the lift. Still last.
Results night. You pack your bags.
First place. Seventeen neighbours voted themselves to the bottom, so you could stay.
Where would you rank in your building? Write it in the comments.
